questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) Differentiate between an Anticline and an Antiform.

(2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
An **anticline** is an arch-shaped fold in which the **oldest rocks are in the core** and the limbs dip away from the fold axis; the age order of the beds is known.

An **antiform** is any arch-shaped (upward-closing) fold whose **age order of the beds is not known or is inverted**; it is a purely geometrical (shape) term, so an antiform is not necessarily an anticline.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(b) Draw a normal fault and label the following parts; the hanging wall and the net slip.

(3 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Drawing to be made by the candidate (3 marks).** Elements to draw:

1. Two blocks of rock with horizontal layers, separated by a **steeply inclined fault plane** (dipping about $60^\circ$ to $70^\circ$).
2. The block lying **above** the fault plane is the **hanging wall**; it has moved **down** relative to the other block (the footwall) - arrows show the relative movement.
3. The layers on the two sides are displaced; the **net slip** is the true displacement measured **along the fault plane** between two points that were once together (the same bed on both sides). Mark it with a line along the fault plane joining the two ends of the displaced bed.
4. Label: fault plane, hanging wall, footwall, net slip.

Marks: correct fault drawn with the hanging wall moved down (1), hanging wall labelled (1), net slip labelled (1).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) (i) List THREE types of magma.

(3 marks)

(ii) State with a reason, the grain size of an igneous rock formed in a volcanic environment.

Grain size ........ (1 mark)

Reason ........ (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i)** Three types of magma: **basaltic** (mafic) magma, **andesitic** (intermediate) magma and **rhyolitic** (felsic, acidic or granitic) magma.

**(ii)** **Grain size:** fine-grained (very small crystals, sometimes glassy).

**Reason:** in a volcanic (extrusive) environment the lava is erupted at the surface and **cools quickly**, so the crystals have little time to grow.
